scope.objective: stable static quality-latency frontier and dynamic-adaptation feasibility gate for the validated Table-5 proxy

fixed_model_protocol.decoding: greedy argmax; exactly 512 SwiftLLM generation steps
fixed_model_protocol.quantization: uniform NF4 W4 bitsandbytes proxy; blocksize 64
fixed_model_protocol.w4_prefill: bitsandbytes.matmul_4bit multi-row fallback that dequantizes temporary weights
fixed_model_protocol.layer_order: front-to-back layers [0,N); fixed for all N
fixed_model_protocol.warmup: one excluded request with the first frozen prompt and 8 generated tokens

quality.primary_metric: macro mean per-request DuReader whitespace-stripped character-overlap F1 against best reference
quality.paired_comparison: join every W4 request to FP16 by stable request_id; report all per-request deltas
quality.uncertainty: 10000-request paired nonparametric bootstrap, percentile 95% CI, seed 2025
quality.secondary_metric_predeclared: FP16-vs-W4 position-aligned output-token agreement, exact-sequence agreement, and longest common prefix; mechanism evidence only
quality.nonmonotonic_policy: report unchanged; use secondary output agreement to diagnose quantization distortion; do not discard or retune examples

calibration.workload_rule: frozen source sequences 42..105 inclusive, normalized to zero and time-dilated
calibration.knee_rule: in ascending offered load, first point with any of: SLO violation rate >=20%, P95 queueing >=2 s, or peak logical KV utilization >=0.85; select it and its adjacent load points, using the nearest three points at a boundary
calibration.freeze_rule: record selected three scales and designate the middle selected point as near-knee before any v5 W4 run

serving.repeats: one run at each selected load plus a second run for every condition at near-knee; add a third near-knee repeat if ordering changes materially
serving.final_protocol: 1024-token prompts, 512 output steps, frozen dense BurstGPT trace shape
reported_metrics: arrival-to-scheduler, prefill/post-admission, and decode/TPOT timing where available
logical KV utilization and GPU block count

fields: peak temporary prefill workspace = profile peak allocation - persistent allocation
safe profiled GPU KV blocks and token slots

eligibility_gate.stability: all runs complete 64/64; two profile probes agree within 5% in KV blocks and workspace; near-knee ordering is consistent or a third repeat is run
eligibility_gate.resource_relief: quantized state has >5% more safe KV blocks than FP16, or repeated serving evidence identifies another pressure-relief mechanism
eligibility_gate.latency_advantage: at near-knee, W4 has lower P95 TTFT and lower strict SLO rate than matched FP16 in both repeats, and mean P95 reduction exceeds the larger run-to-run P95 range (or 5% of FP16 mean if both ranges are zero)
eligibility_gate.mechanism_alignment: queue/KV/HBM evidence must support the claimed relief; lower resident weights alone is insufficient
eligibility_gate.classification: FP16 is the reference state; each W4 state is ELIGIBLE only if all applicable stability, resource-relief, latency-advantage, and mechanism-alignment gates pass

dynamic_gate.go: at least one W4 state is ELIGIBLE and quality has either a paired distinction or independently verified output-agreement distortion
dynamic_gate.no_go: no W4 state has a stable same-workload advantage, temporary prefill workspace prevents safe relief, or noise prevents classification
